jsonLd.name: Lymphatic Body Massage in Miami
jsonLd.description: Lymphatic body massage is a full-body manual drainage technique that mobilises fluid through the superficial lymphatic system to support recovery before and after body procedures and to deliver stand-alone wellness benefits, performed in a 60-minute session by trained therapists at our Miami clinic.

mainEntity.name: Why is lymphatic body massage so important after endolaser?

acceptedAnswer.text: Across any treated body zone, post-procedure swelling is part of the normal healing pattern. Manual lymphatic drainage helps mobilise the fluid, prevents stagnation in the treated tissues, and supports a smoother, cleaner final contour. We recommend starting between day three and five and continuing with several sessions during the first weeks. Patients who follow the schedule consistently tend to show a better contour at the three-month review.

mainEntity.name: When can I start drainage after a procedure?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most endolaser cases we begin between day three and five, when the inflammatory peak begins to settle. After traditional liposuction or other body-contouring surgery, the operating surgeon defines the start date. We never begin drainage on a treated area without the prescribing physician's authorisation, since premature drainage can be uncomfortable and counterproductive.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: After endolaser for small areas, three to five sessions is typical. After medium areas, six to eight. After large areas — full abdomen, abdomen and flanks, full thighs — we plan eight to twelve sessions concentrated during the first weeks, with continued cadence as needed. As wellness, a single session is meaningful; a regular cadence over time produces a more sustained effect.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Critical adjuvant after endolaser procedures: supports resolution of swelling, prevents fluid stagnation and refines the final contour across small, medium or large areas.
Recommended adjuvant after traditional liposuction or other body-contouring surgeries when the operating surgeon authorises drainage.
Reduces sensation of leg heaviness and ankle puffiness associated with prolonged standing, sedentary work or Miami's climate.
Eases premenstrual fluid retention and the sensation of bloating.
Supports recovery after long-haul flights, when systemic fluid distribution is altered.
Creates a deep state of relaxation thanks to the slow, rhythmic, predictable nature of the strokes.
No downtime and no marks: patients return to their day immediately after the session.
